title: Google is testing a homepage without a Search button
excerpt: Signed-out users are seeing three AI shortcuts where the Search button used to be. Two work without an account, one does not.
content_html:
Google is testing a homepage with no Search button. A small group of signed-out users see three AI shortcuts in its place, and the familiar layout returns the moment they log in.

Search Engine Watch spotted the change on Monday and reproduced it across Chrome, Microsoft Edge and Perplexity’s Comet browser. Three buttons sit under the search bar: Create images, Ask about files and Brainstorm.

The AI Mode button stays inside the search box itself. “I’m feeling lucky” survives, as it has survived every previous redesign.

The button that asks for a login

Two of the three shortcuts need no account at all. Ask about files takes an upload and answers questions about the document. Brainstorm opens a conversation with Gemini.

Create images does not. It stops at a sign-in wall, and it is the only one of the three that does.

Neither outlet says why, and Google has not explained the difference. The plain reading is cost. Reading a file the user supplies is cheap, and generating pictures with Nano Banana is not.

Search Engine Watch also found the reverse holds. The three shortcuts vanished on signing in, then came back on signing out again.

Nobody can say how wide this goes

Android Authority wrote the finding up and could not reproduce it. Taylor Kerns tried several browsers and several VPN locations, and saw the old homepage every time.

That is ordinary for an A/B test, and it is also the limit of what anyone knows. Location, browser and session all appear to matter. Google has confirmed nothing about the size of the test, or whether it ships.

Digital Trends picked the story up the same day. Shikhar Mehrotra repeated the same caveat: a select group of logged-out visitors, and not all of them.

Why the signed-out visitor is the one being tested

The choice of audience looks deliberate. A signed-out visitor is the person Google knows least about, and the one most likely to be trying something else.

Comet is one of the browsers the new layout turned up in. That browser sits at the centre of a shopping ruling Amazon lost, over agents acting for a user inside someone else’s storefront.

Search is under pressure from the same direction. Publishers have watched referral traffic fall as AI answers take the top of the page, and the open web has paid for it.

What a test does not prove

An A/B test is not a product decision. Google runs thousands of them, and most of what it tries never reaches a general release.

The company also has an obvious reason to leave the search box alone. Ten blue links still fund almost everything else, and analysts have spent two years asking whether that dominance is cracking.

Sign-in is its own thread here. Google has been pushing account verification harder across its products, including a selfie video check for people recovering an account.

The homepage is the most conservative surface Google owns, and it has changed very little in more than two decades. That is why taking one button off it is worth noticing, even when only a handful of people can see it. Whether those people keep it is the part nobody outside Google knows.

content_html_zh:
谷歌正在测试没有搜索按钮的主页。 一小群已注销的用户会在其位置看到三个人工智能快捷方式，并且在他们登录后就会返回熟悉的布局。

搜索引擎观察周一发现了这一变化，并在 Chrome、Microsoft Edge 和 Perplexity 的 Comet 浏览器上重现了这一变化。 搜索栏下方有三个按钮：创建图像、询问文件和头脑风暴。

AI 模式按钮位于搜索框内。 “我感觉很幸运”得以幸存，就像它在之前的每次重新设计中都幸存下来一样。

要求登录的按钮

三个快捷方式中的两个根本不需要帐户。 询问文件需要上传并回答有关文档的问题。 头脑风暴开启了与双子座的对话。

创建图像则不然。 它停在签到墙前，这是三处签到墙中唯一的一处。

两家媒体都没有说明原因，谷歌也没有解释其中的差异。 简单的阅读是有成本的。 读取用户提供的文件很便宜，而使用 Nano Banana 生成图片则不然。

搜索引擎观察还发现了反向保留。 这三个快捷方式在登录时消失，然后在再次注销时恢复。

没有人能说清楚这个范围有多大

Android Authority 记录了这一发现，但无法重现。 Taylor Kerns 尝试了多个浏览器和多个 VPN 位置，每次都看到旧主页。

这对于 A/B 测试来说很平常，也是任何人所知道的极限。 位置、浏览器和会话似乎都很重要。 谷歌尚未证实该测试的规模以及是否发货。

数字趋势当天报道了这个故事。 Shikhar Mehrotra 重复了同样的警告：一组选定的注销访客，而不是全部。

为什么正在测试的是已退出的访问者

观众的选择看起来是经过深思熟虑的。 退出的访问者是 Google 最不了解的人，也是最有可能尝试其他事情的人。

Comet 是出现新布局的浏览器之一。 该浏览器是亚马逊输掉的一项购物裁决的核心，因为代理在别人的店面内为用户代理。

搜索面临着来自同一方向的压力。 随着人工智能答案占据页面顶部，出版商看到推荐流量下降，而开放网络为此付出了代价。

测试不能证明什么

A/B 测试不是产品决策。 谷歌运行了数千个这样的应用程序，而且它尝试的大部分内容从未发布过。

该公司还有一个明显的理由不理会搜索框。 十个蓝色链接仍然为几乎所有其他东西提供资金，分析师花了两年时间询问这种主导地位是否正在破裂。

登录在这里是它自己的线程。 谷歌一直在其产品中加大力度推动账户验证，包括为恢复账户的人们提供自拍视频检查。

主页是谷歌拥有的最保守的界面，二十多年来几乎没有什么变化。 这就是为什么取下一颗纽扣是值得注意的，即使只有少数人可以看到它。 这些人是否保留它是谷歌之外没有人知道的部分。
